```yaml
name: Secrets Diagnostics

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      debug:
        description: 'Enable debug logging'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  diagnose-tokens:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN
        id: check-agent-token
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ secrets.GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN }}" ]; then
            echo "status=present" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "length=$(echo -n "${{ secrets.GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN }}" | wc -c)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "status=missing" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "length=0" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Check GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN
        id: check-aw-github-token
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ secrets.GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN }}" ]; then
            echo "status=present" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "length=$(echo -n "${{ secrets.GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN }}" | wc -c)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "status=missing" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "length=0" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Check GITHUB_TOKEN
        id: check-default-token
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ github.token }}" ]; then
            echo "status=present" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "length=$(echo -n "${{ github.token }}" | wc -c)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "status=missing" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "length=0" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Determine Effective Token Chain
        id: effective-chain
        run: |
          echo "=== Token Precedence Chain Analysis ==="
          echo "1. GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN: ${{ steps.check-agent-token.outputs.status }}"
          echo "2. GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.check-aw-github-token.outputs.status }}"
          echo "3. GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.check-default-token.outputs.status }}"
          
          if [ "${{ steps.check-agent-token.outputs.status }}" == "present" ]; then
            echo "effective=GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "fallback_used=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [ "${{ steps.check-aw-github-token.outputs.status }}" == "present" ]; then
            echo "effective=GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "fallback_used=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [ "${{ steps.check-default-token.outputs.status }}" == "present" ]; then
            echo "effective=GITHUB_TOKEN" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "fallback_used=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "effective=NONE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "fallback_used=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Report Results
        run: |
          echo "Effective Token Source: ${{ steps.effective-chain.outputs.effective }}"
          echo "Fallback Used: ${{ steps.effective-chain.outputs.fallback_used }}"
          
          if [ "${{ steps.effective-chain.outputs.effective }}" == "NONE" ]; then
            echo "::error::No valid GitHub token found in the precedence chain. Assign-to-agent operations will fail."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "::notice::Valid token found: ${{ steps.effective-chain.outputs.effective }}"
          fi
```
